mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM tb_user_article_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, c.article_id AS articleId, a.article_title AS articleTitle, a.article_cover AS articleCover, c.create_time AS createTime FROM tb_user_article_collect c JOIN tb_article a ON c.article_id = a.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limitCurrent}, #{size}
